Appendix table 7. Adults exiting probation, by type of exit and jurisdiction, 2021

Note: Based on reported data only. Details may sum to totals due to rounding. See appendix table 6 for imputed exits from probation. Counts may not be actual as reporting agencies may provide estimates on some or all detailed data.
a/Includes adults on probation who were discharged from supervision when they did not complete the conditions of probation or fulfill obligations.

b/Includes 14,262 adults on probation who transferred to another jurisdiction and 104,107 who exited supervision for other reasons, including administrative closure; appeal; deportation; discharge from pretrial supervision; dismissed cases; duplicate numbers; expired cases; transfer to non-reporting probation; and discharges that could not be reported, classified, or tracked by agencies.
c/Some or all data were estimates.
Source: Bureau of Justice Statistics, Annual Probation Survey, 2021.
